briefing.quote: The core competitiveness in the agent era is no longer how big your model is, but how smoothly your workflow runs.

articles.title: OpenClaw v2.4 Released: Native Multi-Agent Orchestration Fully Opened Up
articles.summary: The new release introduces the Agent Swarm orchestrator, enabling parallel multi-agent collaboration and automatic task decomposition, allowing developers to dispatch dozens of sub-agents within a single session.
articles.detail: OpenClaw's official blog published version v2.4 in the early hours of today, with the core update being the Agent Swarm orchestrator. The orchestrator allows the primary agent to automatically break down subtasks based on task complexity and distribute them to sub-agents equipped with different Skill Packs for parallel execution. Official benchmarks show that on complex code migration and data analysis tasks, end-to-end time dropped by about 62% compared with single-agent mode. The new version also strengthens sandbox isolation, with each sub-agent running in an independent container and supporting fine-grained, capability-based permission grants.
articles.impact: Mature multi-agent orchestration will significantly lower the barrier for enterprises to deploy complex AI workflows. Developers can shift their focus from prompt engineering to process design, accelerating large-scale agent deployment in customer service, R&D, operations, and other scenarios.

articles.title: OpenClaw Ecosystem Skill Marketplace Surpasses 5,000 Skill Packs
articles.summary: Cumulative skill packs listed on the official marketplace have exceeded 5,000, with enterprise automation, data analytics, and cross-system integration skills growing the fastest.
articles.detail: Data from the OpenClaw Skills Hub shows that as of November 1, the total number of skill packs on the marketplace reached 5,127, a month-over-month increase of 28%. Enterprise automation skills (such as ERP integration, ticket workflow routing, and financial reconciliation) account for 23%, making them the fastest-growing category; data analytics and visualization skills follow closely. The official team has also launched a skill quality rating system that scores skill packs across three dimensions — stability, security audit, and maintenance activity — to help users identify high-quality skills.
articles.impact: The explosive growth of the skill marketplace signals that OpenClaw is evolving from a tool into a platform ecosystem. Ordinary users can assemble complex automation flows without coding, and the trend will also create new career opportunities around skill development and maintenance.

articles.title: Official Security Advisory: Post-Mortem of Skill Pack Supply Chain Attack and Protection Recommendations
articles.summary: A third-party skill pack was found to inject suspicious outbound network behavior in an update; the official team removed the affected skill and released a draft whitelist mechanism for supply chain security.
articles.detail: OpenClaw's security team disclosed that a third-party skill pack called DataBridge was found in a late-October version update to contain undeclared outbound network behavior that could leak session context. The official team promptly removed the skill and pushed a cleanup script. The subsequently published draft whitelist mechanism proposes that skill pack updates must include a signed hash, critical permission calls require explicit secondary user confirmation, and a real-name verification and reputation scoring system for skill authors should be established.
articles.impact: The incident exposes supply chain risks amid the rapid expansion of the agent ecosystem. For enterprise users, skill pack auditing and whitelist management will become as important as software dependency governance, making security and compliance capabilities a key factor in vendor selection.

articles.title: Skill of the Week: SheetPilot — Spreadsheet Automation Pack
articles.summary: SheetPilot tops this week's download chart, letting agents directly operate Excel and Google Sheets to perform data cleaning, pivot table generation, and report distribution.
articles.detail: SheetPilot offers a complete set of spreadsheet operation primitives, including formula injection, cross-sheet linking, outlier flagging, and scheduled report pushes. Its standout feature is a built-in "spreadsheet understanding" module that automatically detects merged cells, header hierarchy, and dirty data patterns, avoiding common parsing failures. User feedback shows that monthly financial reconciliation work previously taking 2 hours can now be drafted in 8 minutes after integration.
articles.impact: Spreadsheets remain the core medium of office work worldwide, and skills like this will directly free up large amounts of repetitive office labor, particularly hitting finance, operations, and supply chain roles.

articles.title: BrowserFlow Update: Parallel Multi-Browser Sessions and Persistent Logins
articles.summary: BrowserFlow v1.8 supports managing multiple browser contexts simultaneously, running web scraping, form filling, and competitor monitoring tasks in parallel with independent login states.
articles.detail: The new version introduces a Session Vault mechanism, allowing users to encrypt and store login credentials locally and inject them on demand at runtime, avoiding plaintext exposure. It also supports page-change listening, automatically triggering the skill's self-repair flow when a target page's structure changes. The developers say the skill is now adopted by over 400 e-commerce and market research teams.
articles.impact: Improved stability in browser automation gives agents a genuine ability to "replace RPA," putting structural pressure on traditional RPA vendors to be superseded by skill packs.

articles.title: Must-Have for Developers: CodeReview-Pro Becomes an Open Source Favorite
articles.summary: The CodeReview-Pro skill pack deeply integrates with mainstream Git platforms, automatically identifying high-risk changes and generating security hardening suggestions, with weekly downloads exceeding 30,000.
articles.detail: Optimized for code review scenarios, the skill supports incremental diff analysis, dependency vulnerability scanning, and coding standard consistency checks. Its signature "risk heatmap" feature predicts potential failure points in a change based on historical defect data and prioritizes review focus accordingly. Multiple mid-sized software teams report that after integration, average PR merge time dropped 35% and production P0 incident rates fell 18%.
articles.impact: Intelligentizing code review will significantly boost software delivery quality and speed, while also prompting teams to redefine junior engineers' work content and growth paths.

articles.title: Apple Launches App Intents 2.0: Native Agent Invocation Becomes Reality
articles.summary: The new App Intents framework lets third-party apps expose functionality to system-level agents in a controlled way, enabling users to complete complex cross-app tasks via natural language.
articles.detail: In the latest developer preview, Apple expanded the App Intents framework with multi-step task orchestration and context-passing capabilities. Developers only need to declare intents, parameters, and permissions, and the system agent can then chain together multiple apps to complete functions such as "organize this week's schedule and send an email to the team." Apple emphasized that all sensitive data processing occurs on-device, with only anonymized instructions sent to the cloud.
articles.impact: This marks the iOS ecosystem's shift from "app silos" to "intent-based interconnection." The value anchor of apps moves from UI interaction to callable functionality, opening a new distribution dividend for independent developers.

articles.title: On-Device LLM SDK Update Boosts iPhone 18 Series Inference Speed by Another 40%
articles.summary: Apple updated Core ML and the on-device model runtime to fully leverage the new-generation Neural Engine, enabling 7B-class models to deliver smooth output at 60 tokens per second.
articles.detail: The new SDK introduces dynamic quantization and tiered KV-cache techniques, boosting inference speed for mainstream open-source 7B models on the iPhone 18 Pro by around 40% while cutting power consumption by 22%. A flagship demo app showcased a fully offline personal knowledge-base assistant capable of document retrieval, summarization, and Q&A in airplane mode. Notes, health, and education apps have already announced integrations.
articles.impact: The leap in on-device performance gives privacy-sensitive sectors—healthcare, finance, and personal notes—the confidence to embrace AI. Offline availability will also improve user experience in low-connectivity regions.

articles.title: App Store Annual Trends Report Preview: AI-Native Apps Exceed 25% of Revenue for First Time
articles.summary: Pre-release data shows that in-app purchase revenue from AI-native apps surpassed 25% of total App Store revenue for the first time in the first three quarters of 2026, with subscriptions becoming the dominant model.
articles.detail: The preview highlights productivity tools, creative generation, and personalized learning as the three highest-growth categories for AI-native apps. Notably, leading apps overwhelmingly adopt a "free basics + usage-based subscription" model, with ARPU about 2.3 times higher than traditional apps. However, intensifying homogenized competition has shortened the average app lifespan from 18 months to 11 months.
articles.impact: For developers, AI features have shifted from a differentiation selling point to table stakes. The real competitive edge now lies in scenario depth, data moats, and retention design.
articles.source: App Store Annual Report Preview Page

articles.title: AI Legal Assistant Firm Lexora Raises $120M in Series C
articles.summary: Lexora has closed a Series C round at a $1.8 billion valuation, with its contract review agent deployed in the legal departments of over 300 multinational corporations.
articles.detail: Lexora's flagship product is a contract review agent that deeply understands case law and regulatory provisions, capable of scanning a merger agreement for risks in 3 minutes and generating negotiation recommendations. The company reported annual recurring revenue up 210% year over year, with customer renewal rates holding above 94%. The new capital will fund expansion into Asia-Pacific markets and the build-out of an industry-specific case law knowledge graph.
articles.impact: Legal services have long been viewed as a high-barrier field resistant to automation. Lexora's strong renewal rates demonstrate real willingness to pay for professional-grade agents in knowledge-intensive industries, likely drawing more founders into vertical AI niches.

articles.title: Startup Halcyon Unveils World's First AI-Native OS Prototype
articles.summary: Startup Halcyon has launched AgenticOS, an operating system prototype built for agents that unifies the scheduling of hardware resources, application capabilities, and AI agents.
articles.detail: AgenticOS abstracts the traditional file system into an "intent and capability" model, where users and agents drive task completion by declaring goals. The prototype already supports full end-to-end workflows across basic office, development, and creative scenarios. Founded by veteran operating system and distributed systems engineers, Halcyon has raised $45 million in seed funding from several prominent AI funds.
articles.impact: If the approach proves viable, it could upend the interaction paradigms of today's desktop and mobile operating systems. Key to watch is whether it can break through on ecosystem compatibility and developer migration costs.

articles.title: Robotics Agent Firm Forge Robotics Raises $80 Million
articles.summary: Forge Robotics will use the funding to scale deployment of its agent brains in industrial inspection robots, targeting energy and manufacturing clients.
articles.detail: Forge Robotics combines vision-language-action (VLA) models with multi-agent coordination, enabling inspection robots to autonomously detect equipment anomalies, generate maintenance work orders, and dispatch spare parts. The technology is already live at five major energy companies, with a claimed fault detection accuracy of 97.6%. The company plans to expand into warehousing and port scenarios next year.
articles.impact: Embodied AI is moving from demos to real ROI. Industrial customers' willingness to pay for measurable cost savings and efficiency gains will be the dividing line for the next wave of the robotics sector.

hotProjects.quote: When the wind rises, even pigs can fly; but only those who create the wind decide where they land.
hotProjects.summary: Top trend today: Multi-agent orchestration and vertical industry agent platforms are heating up in parallel, as ecosystem-level opportunities replace competition over single models.

projects.name: AgentMesh — Multi-Agent Orchestration Middleware
projects.oneLiner: An open-source orchestration layer providing task scheduling, state sync, and fault tolerance for multi-agent systems.
projects.whyHot: With OpenClaw's multi-agent capabilities opened up, the market urgently needs a standardized orchestration and governance layer. AgentMesh delivers a cross-framework agent communication protocol and observability tools, gaining 18,000 GitHub stars in two weeks. It has been added to the tech shortlists of multiple SaaS vendors and is seen as a leading candidate for the "Kubernetes of the agent era."
highlights: Built-in agent behavior auditing and cost tracking
Supports self-healing and task retry strategies
Dual-track model: open source + commercial hosting
projects.riskTip: Standards for the orchestration layer have yet to be unified; if tech giants release official solutions, middleware projects risk being marginalized.

projects.name: SheetPilot — Office Spreadsheet Automation Skill Pack
projects.oneLiner: Enables agents to directly read and operate spreadsheets, replacing large volumes of repetitive office work.
projects.whyHot: Spreadsheets are the world's largest carrier of office data, and SheetPilot solves the most frequent workplace pain point at minimal integration cost. It topped the skill marketplace download charts this week, with a paid-team conversion rate three times the industry average, validating the "small entry point + high-frequency scenario" product methodology.
highlights: Automatically detects merged cells and dirty data patterns
Out-of-the-box templates for financial reconciliation, report generation, and more
Runs locally — sensitive data never leaves the corporate network
Two-way sync with mainstream office suites
projects.riskTip: Office suite vendors may cover this functionality directly through system-level features; a template ecosystem and industry know-how barriers must be built quickly.

projects.name: Lexora — AI Legal Contract Review Agent
projects.oneLiner: A contract risk scanning and negotiation advisory agent for corporate legal teams.
projects.whyHot: Law is a quintessential knowledge industry with high deal values and strong compliance demands. Lexora has proven the commercial viability of vertical agents with a 94% renewal rate and 210% ARR growth, having just closed a $120 million Series C at a $1.8 billion valuation, becoming a benchmark in the vertical track.
highlights: A knowledge graph deeply versed in case law and regulatory provisions
Completes M&A-grade contract risk scans in 3 minutes
Serves legal departments at 300+ multinational corporations
Continuously builds a proprietary industry data flywheel
projects.riskTip: Regulatory gaps remain around liability for AI-generated legal advice; a single major misjudgment could erode trust across the entire industry.

projects.name: AgenticOS (Halcyon) — AI-Native Operating System
projects.oneLiner: An agent-native operating system prototype that replaces files and windows with intents and capabilities.
projects.whyHot: As agents become the primary interaction layer, the operating system is inevitably entering a rebuild window. AgenticOS was the first to present a complete "intent-driven" system design. Its founding team boasts an impressive pedigree and has raised a $45 million seed round; though still extremely early, its narrative upside is vast — a classic high-risk, high-ceiling bet.
highlights: Intent-capability abstraction replaces traditional file systems
Unified agent scheduling of hardware and application resources
End-to-end demos across office, development, and creative workflows
Backed by top-tier AI funds, with high talent density
projects.riskTip: The probability of success in the OS space is extremely low; ecosystem compatibility and user habit migration are the biggest obstacles, making commercialization difficult in the short term.
